title: Oversight of the constitutionality of laws in the Jordanian political system: a comparative study
core_idea: To identify the extent to which constitutionality of laws is applied in the Jordanian political system by reviewing political and judicial oversight types, in light of the 2011 constitutional amendments that established the constitutional court, using international (US, France) and regional (Egypt) comparisons.
tldr: A descriptive comparative study that reviews political and judicial mechanisms for constitutional review in Jordan after the 2011 amendments, comparing oversight types with the US, France and Egypt to assess how constitutionality of laws is applied.
